title: Ambiguous Clues
author: GiAnMMV
rules:
Rules:

• Classic Sudoku: Every row, column and 3x3 box must contain every number from 1 to 9.

• Ambiguous Clues: All clues outside the grid with the same color represent the same rule; two clues of different colors cannot represent the same rule. The possible rules are:

• Skyscrapers: Each digit in the grid represents the height of a building in its cell, and taller buildings obstruct the view of shorter ones behind them: a clue gives the number of buildings visible from that vantage point in the clue’s row or column.

• Sandwich Sums: A clue indicates the sum of the digits between 1 and 9 in the indicated row or column.

• X-Sums: A clue indicates the sum of the first X digits of its row or column, where X is the digit placed in the first cell in that direction.

• Numbered Rooms: A clue indicates the digit which has to be placed in the Xth cell in the corresponding direction, where X is the digit placed in the first cell in that direction.
